name: Motors
description:
TYPE values (use the full label, not an abbreviation):
  Brushed DC
  Brushless DC
  AC Induction
  Servo (any feedback type)
  Geared Motor (motor + gearbox sold as one SKU)
  Tubular (rolling-shutter / awning tubular motor)
  Stepper
  Hydraulic Power Pack (motor + pump + tank as one SKU)

BRAND = exact brand name on the nameplate (preserve casing). Use 'GEN' when the source is unbranded.

BRAND MODEL NO. = manufacturer / supplier part number, as written on the datasheet (preserve hyphens, suffixes, alphanumeric codes). When both a marketing name and an order code exist (e.g., 'PRESIDENT 3M' + 'AA50091'), use the marketing name followed by the order code in parentheses.

KEY SPEC = ONE short, distinguishing figure that helps a reader recognise this SKU at a glance:
  - boom barriers       → rated torque (e.g., '100Nm')
  - shutter motors      → rated power (e.g., '370W')
  - gate operators      → gate capacity (e.g., '1400kg')
  - servo motors        → rated power (e.g., '200W')
  - power packs         → motor power (e.g., '1.5kW')
Full electrical + mechanical specs (voltage, phase, RPM, torque, capacity, IP rating, etc.) go in custom_fields.specs — NOT in the item name. The name stays short.

Drives (e.g., MSD100 standalone servo drives) are NOT Motor items — they belong under a future 'Drives' L3 and should be omitted from this L3.

name: Sensors
standard: IEC 60947-5-2 (Proximity Switches), IEC 60825 (Optical Safety)
description:
TYPE values (use the full label):
  Photoelectric    - industrial automation; sensing mode (thru-beam / retro / diffuse) goes in the key-spec token
  Proximity        - inductive or capacitive
  Reed Switch      - magnetically actuated
  Microwave        - microwave or radar (motion or presence)
  Active Infrared  - presence / curtain detection
  Loop Detector    - vehicle presence (inductive loop or radar-loop)
  Light Barrier    - door-safety light barriers, edge protection
  Encoder          - rotary or linear position feedback
  Limit Switch     - mechanical end-of-travel
  Pressure Sensor
  Other

BRAND = exact brand name on the datasheet (preserve casing). Use 'GEN' when unbranded.

BRAND MODEL NO. = manufacturer / supplier part number exactly as written. When a colour / housing variant exists (e.g., PrimeMotion C bk vs si vs wt), append the colour suffix to the model: 'PrimeMotion C bk'.

KEY SPEC = ONE short, distinguishing figure:
  - microwave / radar     → sensing range or detection zone (e.g., '6-10m', '6x3m zone')
  - light barriers        → range + mode (e.g., '30m thru-beam')
  - photoelectric         → range + mode (e.g., '15m thru-beam')
  - active IR             → range (e.g., '2.7m presence')
  - loop detectors        → zone size (e.g., '6x3m zone')
  - reed switches         → contact form + voltage rating (e.g., '1A NO 200VDC')
Full supply / output / IP / technology specs go in custom_fields.specs — NOT in the item name.
